component.name: Mustek ScanExpress A3 USB PRO
component.summary: Scan with the Mustek ScanExpress A3 USB PRO flatbed scanner

description.p: A command-line and graphical tool for the Mustek ScanExpress A3 USB PRO flatbed scanner. It talks to the scanner directly over USB with no proprietary drivers required.

ul.li: Full A3 scanning at up to the scanner's native resolution
Adjustable scan window and top trim
PNG, JPEG and multi-page TIFF output
